title: Fed holds rates at 3.5% as markets question Warsh's communication and funding costs hit 19-year highs
summary: The U.S. central bank leaves rates unchanged, core inflation eases in line with expectations, and investors view the Fed chair's new communication strategy as counterproductive.

title: Microsoft surges 17% in stock market and Meta plunges 8% after quarterly results
summary: The market rewards Microsoft's cloud strength and recovery in AI investment, while punishing Meta's weak results.

title: Bank of England holds interest rates at 3.75% for fifth consecutive meeting
summary: The British institution leaves its benchmark rate unchanged amid uncertainty over the energy shock.

title: Yen surges up to 3% on Japan's intervention and Bessent's support
summary: Tokyo buys yen and the currency touches 157 per dollar, while the U.S. Treasury secretary considers the yen to be deeply undervalued.

title: Amazon beats forecasts with record profits while Apple disappoints due to supply problems
summary: Cloud drives Amazon's results, while the semiconductor shortage slows Apple and weighs on its share price.

title: KOSPI rebounds more than 16% with Samsung and SK Hynix as South Korean investors suffer from AI
summary: The South Korean stock market recovers after the Wall Street rally and analysts back SK Hynix, although retail investors are still hurting from the bursting of the AI bubble.

title: KKR raises profit 40% while Blue Owl struggles in private credit fundraising
summary: U.S. alternative asset managers post contrasting results: KKR books record capital gains and Blue Owl records its slowest fundraising in three years.

title: Deutsche Bank moves from excessive enthusiasm to an overcorrection
summary: The German bank suffers a sharp stock market adjustment after the market had raised expectations too much.

title: Adidas plunges in stock market due to increased marketing spending during the World Cup
summary: Football's appeal does not offset the rise in commercial costs and the market punishes the sports brand.

title: A hedge fund linked to a former OpenAI researcher widens losses on AI stock slump
summary: Citadel has acquired positions in the fund, which has suffered a major setback from the collapse of AI technology stocks.
